title: Port the granted-worktree arm of route set (kill the Err2::Ex bail)
action: run_route (workflows.rs ~620-624) bails with Err2::Ex when code_touching && any_granted_worktree, surfacing as a misleading unsupported_argument_shape refusal and deadlocking multi-worktree operation (P1 backlog finding, feature counter-teeth). Port the retired Node arm: a grant for the TARGET feature routes the worktree block to that grant; a grant for a DIFFERENT feature must not poison the call; any genuine refusal names the actual conflict. Red-first tests: route set succeeds with a foreign grant present; succeeds with own-feature grant; refusal message contract pinned.

truths: route set green with foreign worktree grant present
route set green with own-feature grant
no path surfaces unsupported_argument_shape for this arm
